title: fix(ui): keep selected slash argument when selecting text
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Keyboard text selection in a slash-command argument draft refreshed the menu and reset the highlighted argument to the first row. Tab could therefore complete `default` instead of the operator's selected `ultra`.

The existing slash menu owner retains the selected value while the same argument draft remains active. Changed drafts/commands retire that selection; refreshed options preserve it by value or fall back when it disappears. Reuses the constructed command draft rather than allocating it twice. No new keyboard owner, model-selection policy, Gateway normalization or server-echo change.

Preserves ly85206559's original commits.

## Evidence

[Inspected Chromium/Linux WebKit before-and-after screenshots, actual RPC fields, controls and measurements](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/194087#issuecomment-6685064869).

Built Gateway serves built Control UI in secretless Node24.22.1 Docker. **Main twice and exact head twice in each engine**, eight successful scenes. ArrowUp highlights `ultra`; Shift+ArrowLeft causes a native text-selection event. Main resets to `default`; the candidate retains `ultra`. Tab completes the argument, and normal Enter submission emits actual `sessions.patch` with `thinkingLevel:null` on main versus `"ultra"` on the candidate; real Gateway replies succeed. Mouse selection, default Enter and Escape are unchanged. No model turn is made.

Linux WebKit uses the disclosed driver-only correction retaining MiniBrowser's native disabled PushAPI default; no product/page API or platform spoof.

**Checks:** 16 owner/component tests and 4 focused UI E2E cases pass. Both amended regressions fail on main. Coverage is consolidated into existing owner/viewport and E2E cases: **tests net−1**, allocation removed; production **+19/−4 (23 gross)**.

**Real served gzip growth:** Chat **+311 B**, startup **−7 B**, combined **+304 B**, below600 B. Canonical hash-normalized growth is **+87 B**, with the comparator passing and no caps or allowances changed.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door: reverting fully restores prior UI behavior; no migration or new persisted contract. Blast radius is selected slash-command argument fidelity in the chat composer. Existing model policy and Gateway validation remain authoritative.
